title: Fresh Cart and Submission Status

sections.name: Task sessions
items: Starting a new task clears the selected harvester's old cart cookies, site storage, and cache before checkout or queue monitoring begins.
A queue pass or CAPTCHA resume keeps the current task's session, so it does not lose its place mid-checkout.
After Brava restarts, an old Needs You or Submitting order task becomes Stopped with a reminder to verify the order before starting again.

sections.name: Checkout progress
items: Tasks now show Submitting order after Place Order is clicked and before Checked out is confirmed.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
